target.title: fix(heartbeat): allow cron-triggered wakes regardless of per-agent heartbeat config
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Cron jobs targeting `sessionTarget: "main"` with `payload.kind: "systemEvent"` were recorded as `status=skipped` / `error="disabled"` on every run. The main session was never woken.

Fixes #101537.

## Root Cause / Fix

**Root cause**: `runHeartbeatOnce` checks `isHeartbeatEnabledForAgent` unconditionally. When a user configures explicit heartbeat agents but "main" lacks its own `heartbeat` block, `isHeartbeatEnabledForAgent` returns false for "main". Cron calls `runHeartbeatOnce({source:"cron",...})` → returns `{status:"skipped", reason:"disabled"}` → cron records the run as skipped and the systemEvent is never delivered.

**Fix**: Skip the per-agent heartbeat gates when `opts.source === "cron"`. The cron system manages its own scheduling independently of per-agent heartbeat configuration. The global `areHeartbeatsEnabled()` gate still applies.

## Evidence

### Before/after

**Before** (issue reporter, 2026.7.1-beta.2):

```json
[
  { "status": "skipped", "error": "disabled", "deliveryStatus": "not-requested", "durationMs": 19 },
  { "status": "skipped", "error": "disabled", "deliveryStatus": "not-requested", "durationMs": 22 }
]
```

**After** — the per-agent gate is skipped for cron source. The fix is a 5-line guard:

```diff
+  if (opts.source !== "cron") {
     if (!isHeartbeatEnabledForAgent(cfg, agentId)) { ... }
     if (!resolveHeartbeatIntervalMs(cfg, undefined, heartbeat)) { ... }
+  }
```

### Gate proof — isHeartbeatEnabledForAgent on explicit agent configs

```text
$ node --import tsx -e '
import { isHeartbeatEnabledForAgent } from "./src/infra/heartbeat-summary.js";
console.log(isHeartbeatEnabledForAgent({agents:{list:[
  {id:"worker", heartbeat:{every:"5m"}}, {id:"main"}
]}}, "main"));
'

false  ← gate rejects main; cron source now bypasses it
```

### Regression tests

**Integration test** — `src/cron/service.main-job-passes-heartbeat-target-last.test.ts`:

```text
$ npx vitest run src/cron/service.main-job-passes-heartbeat-target-last.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ should pass heartbeat.target=last to runHeartbeatOnce for wakeMode=now main jobs 204ms
 ✓ should preserve heartbeat.target=last when wakeMode=now falls back to requestHeartbeat 17ms
 ✓ should preserve heartbeat.target=last for wakeMode=next-heartbeat main jobs 14ms
 ✓ does not skip with 'disabled' when the agent has no explicit heartbeat config 15ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
```

**Unit test** — `src/infra/heartbeat-runner.returns-default-unset.test.ts`:

```text
$ npx vitest run src/infra/heartbeat-runner.returns-default-unset.test.ts -t "skips when agent|does not return disabled for cron" --reporter=verbose

 ✓ skips when agent heartbeat is not enabled
 ✓ does not return disabled for cron source even when the agent is not in the heartbeat list

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed | 42 skipped (44)
```

### Scheduler regression — no breakage

```text
$ npx vitest run src/infra/heartbeat-runner.scheduler.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  25 passed (25)
```

### oxfmt / oxlint / whitespace

- `oxfmt --check` — ✅
- `oxlint` — ✅
- `git diff --check` — ✅

### Autoreview

```text
autoreview --mode branch --engine claude --model claude-sonnet-5
overall: patch is correct (0.9)
findings: 2 (both P3, non-blocking)
```

## Change Type / Scope / Security Impact

- **Type**: fix
- **Scope**: `src/infra/heartbeat-runner.ts`
- **Files**: 2 source + 2 test (+25 source, +62 test)
- **Security**: No security impact
- **Backward compatibility**: Non-cron sources unchanged
